# victorops_contact (Resource)

Manages a contact (email or phone number) for a user. A phone contact must be verified manually in the web UI before it can be used in a paging policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_contact" "jdane_cell" {
  user_name = victorops_user.jdane.user_name
  type      = "phone"
  value     = "+13038674309"
  label     = "Cell Phone"
}

resource "victorops_contact" "jdane_email" {
  user_name = victorops_user.jdane.user_name
  type      = "email"
  value     = "jdane@example.com"
  label     = "Work Email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) A label for this contact (e.g., 'Work Phone', 'Personal Email').
- `type` (String) The type of contact: 'phone' or 'email'.
- `user_name` (String) The username of the user this contact belongs to.
- `value` (String) The contact value (email address or phone number).

### Read-Only

- `computed_value` (String) The contact value as formatted by the VictorOps API.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `internal_id` (Number) The internal ID of the contact.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import victorops_contact.jdane_cell <username>/<contact_type>/<external_id>
```
